environment: Playwright 1.64.1 Chromium, software WebGL (SwiftShader), reduced motion; desktop 1440x1000 and an emulated 390x844 touch phone (Chromium touch emulation, not a physical device)
mode: Example mode on a free local port with scratch data and an empty environment: no credentials, no provider request, no write
steps: Load, close the journal, Time of day: Day; View > Zoom in three times on Hearth Village
Press Explore map (click on desktop, tap on the phone); open View to read its hint, then close it
Drag from clear terrain toward Manor Gardens (mouse on desktop, one finger on the phone) until it is near the middle

images.shows: A close Hearth Village view (three steps in) right after turning Explore map on: the compass pressed, the view unchanged
After three ordinary mouse drags with the compass on: across the river to Manor Gardens at the same scale, no Areas used
The same close village view on the phone right after tapping Explore map; toolbar on one row, no overflow
After one-finger drags (Chromium touch emulation) with the compass on: Manor Gardens named, the forest clear
The existing View menu while exploring: its hint reads 'Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom.'
